detail.longDescription: fmgrep is a (Claude-powered) open source reimplementation of a FAANG code search engine I was involved in a few years back. It's aimed at very large (e.g. AOSP) source trees. Back then we wanted to get our hands on the Github search engine ( https://github.com/danlark1/sparse_ngrams ) but it was not available, so we went a different way. Instead of n-grams,`fmgrep` builds an FM index of the tree with O(pattern) `count` and O(occurrences) `locate`, which is quite cool and leads to blazing fast performance as seen in the benchmarks.
